text: "*" means necessary documents that you must provide in your application.*1. Passport-sized photoA two-inch recent bareheaded, white background identification photo.*2. Passport first page, visa page (please ensure continuity).*3. Certificate/diploma of highest educationThe original or notarized documents of the highest academic qualifications (graduates must provide the certificate of graduation reservation issued by their school) in Chinese and English respectively. Graduation certificate must be certified by the Chinese Embassy (Consulate) in your country or notarized by a notary office in China.*4. Academic transcript of highest educationThe undergraduate applicant will provide the original transcripts or notarized documents of all the courses at the senior secondary level. Transcripts must be certified by the Chinese Embassy (Consulate) in your country or notarized by a notary office in China.5. Photocopy of awards certificateall kinds of award-winning certificates, including sports, art and other aspects of the relevant certificates.
